assessments.name: Participation
assessments.description: Students are expected to actively participate in weekly class discussions, site visits, workshops, and peer learning activities throughout the unit.

assessments.name: Background Essay and Annotated Bibliography
assessments.description: 2000 word Background Essay and Annotated Bibliography. Select a place, landscape, object, or collection and identify the community (or communities) that will form the focus of your research project (further details provided on Canvas).

assessments.description: Presentation (15 minutes): Students will present their developing research in class. Prepare a 10-minute presentation, followed by a 5-minute Q&A discussion (further details provided on Canvas).
